meta.name: TzviAir test world
meta.rule: Everything here is made up. No real customer, phone, address or amount. Phones 050-000xxxx; house numbers 201-299 on real streets; emails @test.tzviair.local.
meta.staffNote: Staff are slots. The seed gives each slot a real person from Admin by role and writes the answer to test_world.staff (slot, person_id, name_he, name_en). Finance and the job board read that table to name the same people.
meta.money: Amounts in shekels with agorot as decimals. beforeVat + vat = withVat on every line.
